_about: energy.json · v0.1 · 2026-10-02. How speech_server.py speaks each energy with Piper, which has no emotion control: the pause between sentences (s), Piper's two variability settings, a pitch lift (synthesised that much slower, then resampled up by the same factor, so the speed is unchanged) and a gain in dB. The pace itself comes with each line from bb_call.js. Kokoro uses gap, lift and gain only.
